name: Kuramei Sprint 3 — Experience Packages + System Prompt Composto
description: Transformar a infra do Sprint 2 em produto usável. Critério de done: alguém que não sabe como o produto funciona envia mensagem natural no WhatsApp e recebe resposta útil.

userStories.title: UISpec types message e list em @kuramei/ui-engine
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, quero novos tipos de UISpec para que o agente possa entregar confirmações, resumos e listas via UI — não apenas mapas.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend @kuramei/ui-engine (NOT a new package — Arcos decision: no split). Organize internally as src/spec/ and src/renderer/ to facilitate future split.
Add MessageSpec to src/spec/schema.ts: { type: 'message'; title: string; body: string; actions?: Array<{ label: string; url: string }> }
Add ListSpec to src/spec/schema.ts: { type: 'list'; title: string; items: Array<{ label: string; description?: string }> }
Update UISpec union type: MapSpec | MessageSpec | ListSpec
Add Zod schemas: MessageSpecSchema and ListSpecSchema
Export all new types and schemas from packages/ui-engine/src/index.ts
Add renderMessage(spec: MessageSpec, token: UISpecToken): string in src/renderer/message.ts — HTML with title, body, and action buttons (if any)
Add renderList(spec: ListSpec, token: UISpecToken): string in src/renderer/list.ts — HTML with title and item list
Both renderers: CSS inline only (no external frameworks or CDN), responsive for mobile, page shows expiration time when valid, 'Link expirado' when expired
CSP header for both types: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'
Update apps/ui-worker/src/renderer.ts to dispatch to correct renderer based on spec.type
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes

userStories.title: Extrair helper generateUI() para uso compartilhado
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, quero uma função generateUI(spec) compartilhável para que tools como create_reminder possam gerar URLs diretamente sem passar pelo ToolRegistry.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract the core logic from packages/tools/src/builtin/generate-ui.ts handler into a standalone async function generateUI(spec: UISpec, context: { userId: string }): Promise<{ url: string }>
Place the helper in packages/sdk/src/generate-ui-helper.ts and export from @kuramei/sdk
The helper must: sign JWT, call Cloudflare KV REST API (same logic as existing tool), return { url: string }
The existing generate_ui tool in @kuramei/tools becomes a thin wrapper that calls generateUI() helper
No breaking changes to the existing tool interface or agent-processor behavior
The helper reads env vars directly (KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, KURAMEI_BASE_URL)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Experience Package Navegação (@kuramei/experience-navigation)
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, quero formalizar a capacidade de navegação como um Experience Package para que o agente aprenda via system prompt quando e como gerar mapas.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/experiences/navigation/ with package.json (name: @kuramei/experience-navigation, version: 0.1.0) and tsconfig.json (extends root tsconfig.base.json)
Add packages/experiences/* to pnpm-workspace.yaml if not already covered by glob
Create src/index.ts exporting navigationExperience: ExperiencePackage (from @kuramei/sdk)
ExperiencePackage interface (from @kuramei/sdk, NO triggerHints — LLM is the only router): { name: string; description: string; systemPromptSection: string; tools: ToolDefinition[] }
navigationExperience.name = 'navigation'
navigationExperience.description = 'Generates navigation maps and location pages'

navigationExperience.systemPromptSection must (in PT-BR): instruct LLM to use generate_ui tool with { type: 'map', query: '<destination>' } when user expresses any intention to go somewhere or needs a map; specify zoom 13 as default; instruct LLM to respond with friendly contextual text alongside the link (e.g. 'Aqui está o mapa para Campinas: <link>. Boa viagem! 🗺️'); instruct LLM to always use query field with place name, never invent coordinates
navigationExperience.tools includes the generate_ui tool definition (import from @kuramei/tools)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: Experience Package Lembrete (@kuramei/experience-reminder)
userStories.description: Como usuário do WhatsApp, quero criar lembretes via mensagem natural e receber uma confirmação visual.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/experiences/reminder/ with package.json (name: @kuramei/experience-reminder, version: 0.1.0) and tsconfig.json
Create src/index.ts exporting reminderExperience: ExperiencePackage

reminderExperience.systemPromptSection must (in PT-BR): instruct LLM to use create_reminder when user asks to be reminded of something; instruct LLM to ask for when if not specified (never create reminder without 'when'); instruct LLM to confirm creation with link: 'Lembrete criado! Confira aqui: <link>'; clarify that create_reminder is only for reminders, not for querying existing reminders
Tool create_reminder with Zod input schema: { text: z.string().min(1), when: z.string().min(1) } — both required (LLM must ask before calling if when is missing)

create_reminder handler: validates input with Zod, generates ulid for id, creates DynamoDB item in table process.env.REMINDERS_TABLE with: PK='USER#<userId>', SK='REMINDER#<ulid>', text, when (as provided), createdAt (ISO string), status='pending'
create_reminder handler: calls generateUI() helper (from @kuramei/sdk) with MessageSpec: { type: 'message', title: 'Lembrete criado ✅', body: '<text> — <when>', actions: [] }
create_reminder handler returns: { success: true, url: string } to the agent
IMPORTANT: create_reminder calls generateUI() helper directly — NOT via ToolRegistry. Tool does NOT call another tool via registry (no circular dependency).
reminderExperience.tools includes create_reminder tool definition
Add REMINDERS_TABLE to env vars documentation (update .env.example)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes

userStories.title: agent-processor com system prompt composto + ExperiencePackage interface
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, quero que o agent-processor carregue todos os Experience Packages e componha o system prompt dinamicamente a partir das capabilities declaradas.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ExperiencePackage interface to @kuramei/sdk (packages/sdk/src/experience-package.ts): { name: string; description: string; systemPromptSection: string; tools: ToolDefinition[] } — NO triggerHints
Add buildSystemPrompt(base: string, packages: ExperiencePackage[]): string to @kuramei/sdk (packages/sdk/src/system-prompt.ts)

buildSystemPrompt output format: '[base]

[== <package.name> ==
<package.systemPromptSection>
]' for each package
Export ExperiencePackage and buildSystemPrompt from packages/sdk/src/index.ts
apps/agent-processor loads navigationExperience and reminderExperience
apps/agent-processor uses buildSystemPrompt to compose final system prompt with base + both packages

System prompt base (in PT-BR): 'Você é o Kuramei, assistente pessoal via WhatsApp. Responde sempre em PT-BR.\nQuando gerar uma UI, sempre acompanhe o link com texto contextual e amigável.\nNunca invente informações — se não souber, diga que não sabe.'
apps/agent-processor registers tools from all packages in ToolRegistry (tools from navigationExperience + reminderExperience)
generate_ui tool must remain available (either via navigationExperience.tools or registered separately)
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm lint passes

userStories.title: Smoke test atualizado com MessageSpec, ListSpec e fluxo de lembrete
userStories.description: Como desenvolvedor, quero que o smoke test cubra os novos tipos de UISpec e o fluxo de lembrete.
acceptanceCriteria: Update scripts/smoke-test.ts with 3 new scenarios (in addition to existing map scenario):

Scenario 'message': creates UISpecToken with MessageSpec { type: 'message', title: 'Confirmação', body: 'Operação realizada com sucesso.', actions: [{ label: 'Ver detalhes', url: 'https://example.com' }] }, writes to KV via wrangler kv:key put, opens URL in browser

Scenario 'list': creates UISpecToken with ListSpec { type: 'list', title: 'Seus lembretes', items: [{ label: 'Tomar remédio', description: 'Hoje às 20h' }, { label: 'Ligar para João' }] }, writes to KV, opens URL in browser

Scenario 'reminder': calls create_reminder handler directly (unit test, not via LLM) with { text: 'Tomar remédio', when: '2026-02-24T20:00:00-03:00' }, verifies it returns { success: true, url: string }, opens URL in browser — NOTE: this scenario requires DynamoDB connection (skip gracefully if REMINDERS_TABLE not set)
All non-DynamoDB scenarios work with just KURAMEI_JWT_SECRET in .env.local and wrangler dev running
Usage: npx tsx scripts/smoke-test.ts [map|message|list|reminder|all] — defaults to 'map' for backward compat
npx tsx scripts/smoke-test.ts all runs all non-DynamoDB scenarios without errors
pnpm build passes (all packages)
pnpm typecheck passes

keyDecisions: No split of @kuramei/ui-engine — extend internally with src/spec/ and src/renderer/ structure
No triggerHints in ExperiencePackage — LLM is the only router
create_reminder calls generateUI() helper directly, NOT via ToolRegistry
generateUI() helper extracted to @kuramei/sdk before US-002/US-003
